intro:
Among my strongest skills are programming in C# and C++, as well as building devices with Arduino. Over the course of my four years in the Degree in Design and Development of Video Games and Interactive Experiences, I have developed numerous games as a programmer, mostly in Unity, with one major project in Unreal. Currently, I am working on a Python-based project aimed at automating a microscope to identify nanoparticles.

Recently, I have shifted my focus to learning Python and programming AI methods, while continuing to explore new technologies in Unreal and maintaining a solid foundation in C++.
